sentences.text: For a Tier 3 UCB, a floating-rate loan granted for a non-business purpose to an individual and sanctioned on or after 1 January 2026 must not have pre-payment charges. [type=fact]
Because the directions say pre-payment charges are not permitted for this case, there is no charge rate to use. [type=fact]
The 2025 directions and the 2014 floating-rate pre-payment circular are both no longer in force on 2026-11-23. [type=chain]

missing.searched: Reviewed the in-force UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 para 261(1) and related pre-payment provisions; no applicable charge rate was found because the case is covered by a prohibition.
